title: 第十二章 暗巷第十三章 激斗
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
黄街，晚上十点半。
随着夜色愈发深沉，人流呈现减少趋势。
盗窃团伙先前的行径，逐渐引起连锁反应。
过去一个小时的时间里。
陈洛已经看到不止一个带着慌张脸色，左顾右盼的游客，在街道快步行走，不时向两边店家询问。
想来，应该都是先前丢失物品的失主。
“乐子，你送他们两个女生回学校吧，顺带帮我跟伟哥他们说一声。”
“我再跟我朋友聚聚。”
眼看快到宿舍熄灯的时间，陈洛提议让其余三人先行回校。
说话间，他的目光掠过四周。
原本于周边徘徊的酒鬼，已经消失不见。
取而代之的，是数个和“小余”年龄相仿，看上去有些吊儿郎当的青年，不时投来若有若无的视线。
“行，那我们先走，洛哥你自己注意安全。”
李佳乐看了眼手表，点点头。
他与陈洛挥手告别，朝着大学的方向走去。
“月月，你哥跟那人...没事吧？”
直到看不见陈洛与“小余”的身影，李佳乐与苏小红，才不约而同地将疑惑目光对准陈月，发出疑惑。
三人并非傻子。
陈洛与“小余”间的异样，他们早早便发现。
只是当事人自己没说什么，他们便不好追问。

“没事的，那人我认识，跟我和我哥都是一个高中的。”
“但他欠我哥的钱不止两百，所以...”
即便压根不认识“小余”，但陈月还是下意识为自己哥哥圆谎。
同时，她也说出了今天出门以来，最长的一段话。
有陈月作保，其余二人很快打消疑惑。
随后。
苏小红凝视着陈月的侧脸，脸上很快浮现坏笑。
“诶，月月。”
“我发现你好像只有说起你哥的时候，话才会变多？”
“你不会是兄控什么的吧，嗯嗯？”
她眼睛眯成月牙，带着八卦的表情，轻轻戳动陈月的腰间。
一旁的李佳乐不敢明目张胆，但也悄然竖起耳朵。
“不是，只是因为我哥很好。”
“他对我，对我弟，对爸妈，都很好。”
“我爸妈以前赚钱不多，要养三个小孩，还要养两边的老人，所以家里很穷。”
“但我跟我弟，从来都不愁吃不愁穿，更不缺钱花，也没被人欺负过，就是因为我哥。”
一说起陈洛。
陈月罕见地昂起头。
她的眼睛在月色映射下，闪烁着明亮光泽。
content_en:
Yellow Street, 10:30 pm.
As the night gets darker, the flow of people shows a decreasing trend.
The previous actions of the theft gang gradually caused a chain reaction.
within the past hour.
Chen Luo has already seen more than one tourist with panicked expressions, looking left and right, walking quickly on the street, asking questions from the shops on both sides from time to time.
Thinking about it, they should all be the owners of previously lost items.
"Lezi, please send these two girls back to school, and help me tell Viagra and the others."
"I'll get together with my friends again."
Seeing that it was almost time to turn off the lights in the dormitory, Chen Luo suggested that the other three go back to school first.
As he spoke, his eyes glanced around.
The drunkard who was wandering around has disappeared.
Instead, there were several young people who were similar in age to "Xiao Yu" and looked a little careless, casting vague glances from time to time.
"Okay, let's go first. Brother Luo, please pay attention to your own safety."
Li Jiale glanced at his watch and nodded.
He waved goodbye to Chen Luo and walked towards the university.
"Yueyue, are your brother and that person... okay?"
It wasn't until Chen Luo and "Xiao Yu" couldn't be seen that Li Jiale and Su Xiaohong unanimously turned their suspicious eyes to Chen Yue and expressed doubts.
The three of them are not fools.
They discovered the difference between Chen Luo and "Xiao Yu" early on.
It's just that the person involved didn't say anything, so it's hard for them to ask questions.
"It's okay. I know that person. My brother and I are in the same high school."
"But he owes my brother more than two hundred, so..."
Even though she didn't know "Xiao Yu" at all, Chen Yue still subconsciously lied for her brother.
At the same time, she also said the longest sentence since she went out today.
With Chen Yue as guarantee, the other two quickly dispelled their doubts.
Subsequently.
Su Xiaohong stared at Chen Yue's side face, and a smirk quickly appeared on her face.
"Hey, Yueyue."
"I noticed that you only talk more when you talk about your brother?"
"You're not a brother-controller or something, huh?"
Her eyes narrowed into crescent moons, and with a gossipy expression, she gently poked Chen Yue's waist.
Li Jiale on the side did not dare to speak openly, but quietly pricked up his ears.
"No, it's just because my brother is very good."
"He is very good to me, my brother, and my parents."
"My parents didn't make much money before. They had to raise three children and the elderly on both sides, so the family was very poor."
"But my brother and I have never had to worry about food, clothing or money, and we have never been bullied. It's all because of my brother."
Speaking of Chen Luo.
Chen Yue raised her head in a rare move.
Her eyes shone brightly under the moonlight.
